categories.main_business_segments: Jing-Jin Electric Technologies Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, sales, and service of electric drive systems for new energy vehicles (NEVs). Its main product lines include electric drive motor assemblies, controllers, transmission assemblies, and related energy storage systems. The company also provides technical development and services, including synchronous development and technical support for vehicle manufacturers. Additionally, it has expanded into electric motorcycle and non-automotive new energy electric drive systems markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced electric drive technologies such as high-efficiency motors using rectangular conductors and amorphous materials, oil-water composite cooling, third-generation silicon carbide semiconductor controllers, multi-in-one integrated electric drive systems, and bistable electromagnetic clutches. It employs system-level integration of motor, controller, and transmission assemblies to achieve high power density, efficiency, and reliability. Production methods emphasize lean manufacturing, real-time data monitoring, and quality control to ensure stable mass production and cost optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jing-Jin Electric serves leading global and domestic automotive manufacturers including Stellantis Group, Ford, FAW, BAIC, SAIC, GAC, Chery, XPeng, BYD, Yutong, Foton, Zhongtong, Qingling, and Hande Axle. Its products cater to passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and electric motorcycles. The company targets both domestic Chinese markets and international markets, especially North America and Europe, with a focus on high-end and mid-to-high-end vehicle segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production and R&D bases in Beijing, Shanghai, Zhengding, Heze, and overseas in Detroit, USA. Its sales and production cover domestic Chinese markets and international markets including North America and Europe. The company is expanding its overseas footprint, leveraging its North American base as a strategic hub for global market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jing-Jin Electric operates as a core upstream and midstream supplier in the new energy vehicle supply chain, specializing in the design, development, and manufacturing of electric drive systems and components. It acts as a first-tier supplier providing integrated electric drive solutions directly to OEMs, playing a critical role in the powertrain segment of NEVs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes original, autonomous, and forward-looking R&D focusing on high integration, high power density, and advanced control technologies for electric drive systems. Key R&D directions include third-generation semiconductor controllers, oil-cooled motors, multi-in-one systems, electromagnetic clutches, and energy storage optimization. It maintains a strong international R&D team and invests heavily in innovation to sustain technological leadership and expand into new market segments such as electric motorcycles and non-automotive applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electric drive system products and technical development and service contracts with automotive OEMs. The company employs a direct sales model with some consignment sales arrangements. It also earns income from synchronous development fees, technical service fees, and mold development fees related to new vehicle projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jing-Jin Electric is positioned as a leading domestic electric drive system supplier with a strategic status as a first-tier supplier to major international and domestic OEMs. It competes with other electric drive system manufacturers in China and internationally, leveraging its advanced technology, system integration capabilities, and early market entry as competitive advantages. The company has established benchmarks in high-end SUV and commercial vehicle electric drive systems and is expanding its presence in global markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.3 billion, a 50.64% increase year-over-year, driven by significant growth in electric drive system sales and technical services. Despite continued net losses (approximately RMB -436 million), losses narrowed by 24.36% compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 2.57 billion with net assets of RMB 579 million. It is in a growth phase with increasing production volumes and expanding market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jing-Jin Electric emphasizes its advanced, highly integrated electric drive systems with superior power density, efficiency, reliability, and low noise. Its proprietary technologies such as bistable electromagnetic clutches and oil-water composite cooling provide competitive differentiation. The company offers system-level optimization and customization capabilities, enabling OEMs to achieve better vehicle performance, energy efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. Its strong R&D and manufacturing capabilities support stable mass production and rapid market response.
